- **Adopted at exact scope:**

FIRST49’s named D2/CORE/shared-core ancestry remains; the old LOWER42/46/48 source DAGs were not newly reconstructed or replayed. This is not separate `I+J` lower-50 acceptance; both owner-ACK MAJORs remain.
  - At any support, the thin-slice gate forces the stated hole rectangles and excludes every wholly thin configuration with nonempty nonofficer support. Separate gates exclude the entire exact30/exact32 officer strata, give every thin value a fat neighbour, exclude the officer-28 stratum and exclude the exact `50/t25/h11/e3` row. These have no `I48/J49` or old numerical-catalogue premise.

Thus 50 is not a full-orbit global minimum value, **not** an unconditional no-exact-50 theorem or proof of an actual support-48 state. Erratum 119 and the named nonloadbearing `NR-U4-ILL` cut remain.
